C1220.title: Judicial Ruling on Big Data Price Discrimination Sets Norms and Advances Digital Economy Governance Rules
C1220.summary: A court in Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province, adjudicated a big data price discrimination case, ordering the platform to refund the consumer and pay triple damages. The ruling defines the scope and extent of a platform operator's duty to inform consumers about transactions with on-platform merchants in the digital economy context, as well as the legal consequences of failing to perform supervisory dutie
